name: semantic-renamed-field
description: Upstream renames User.name to displayName everywhere; the change adds welcome(), which still reads user.name. Each passes alone; merged, welcome() says 'undefined'. The resolver must blame the rename (not the unrelated id helper) and adapt welcome().

plan.title: Welcome-back message
plan.intent: Greet returning users by name on the dashboard.

plan.title: Next free user id
plan.intent: Allocate the next user id after the largest one in use.

plan.title: Rename User.name to displayName
plan.intent: Users choose how they are shown; the field is now displayName everywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: User has displayName and no name
